reason: Actual Claude review after independently passed 1s native parity, before any older labels or model fits.

scope.candidate: One C28.03 Funded EMA20 economic setup, unchanged accepted second kernel; separate HY104 EMA22 SI study not duplicated.
scope.independence: Older sealed year held out for this newly registered ML study only; no universal claim that strategy development never consulted older market behavior.
scope.known_model_performance: No new model-performance/native-payout supplement on the repeatedly used2025/26 year in this study; its role is data-reconstruction acceptance only.

model.primary: StandardScaler fit on each training subset + Ridge(alpha=10,solver=svd)

calibration.a: Unclipped development training mean stress net-R
calibration.b: OLS slope of OOF outcomes on centered chronological OOF predictions, clipped to [0,1]
calibration.center: Mean prediction of final fitted model on its TRAINING inputs; Ridge equals a up to numerical precision
calibration.change_from_original: OOF mean used only to estimate slope, never as final-model prediction center.
calibration.gate: Omit only calibrated expected net-R below zero; no bottom-percentile quota.

futility.if_development_mean_nonpositive: Report a<=0; do not fit final models or release sealed labels. Preserve year for a new separately registered question.

final.primary: Ridge Spearman(calibrated score,stress net-R) on every shadow candidate
final.permutation_strata: Whole ordered daily outcome vectors within calendar-quarter and same daily candidate-count strata; report immovable fraction
final.descriptive_CI: 1999 moving5 actual-session blocks, fixed seed20261121, no refits
final.control: Boosting descriptive only, never selected because final test looks better.
final.one_shot: Atomic durable marker before first sealed data/label byte; crash or concurrent call cannot silently reopen.

economic_endpoint.input: Complete decision-intent stream including entry cancellations, exact int nanosecond JSONL and filled outcome CSV hashbound in role manifest.
economic_endpoint.path: One position/pending entry at a time. Apply gate to each causally available intent; an omitted intent leaves later decisions available. Identical ungated/gated clock logic; no filtering saved fills.
quantities: paired delta-R and delta-USD with 1999 moving5-session intervals
all omitted intents and cancelled entries separately
mean net-R of omitted fillable candidates
economic_endpoint.qualification: Research benefit only if >=10 available fillable omissions, positive delta-R, paired 95% delta-stressUSD interval lower bound>0 and primary Ridge p<=.05. Missing unresolved intent clocks block qualification.
three_outcomes: practically inactive: fewer than10 available fillable omissions

release.sealed_price_completeness_audit_before_o: All required finalized months, row counts/session grids, causal roll/warmup, hash receipts and documented vendor quality, without candidate/outcome construction.

news.primary_policy: No historical news filtering, consistently with acceptance; no unavailable historical feed interpreted as clean coverage.
news.descriptive_flags: Official Federal Reserve calendar dates for policy decisions/press conferences/minutes stored separately, no features/filter/label/weight changes.
news.limits: No historical intraday windows or original point-in-time announcement proof; other news coverage unknown.
